title: Personnel of the early Basie band of thirteen pieces
summary: Jones lists the reeds, trumpets and trombone of the early band, including Lester Young, Buster Smith and Hot Lips Page, and Herschel and Lester's switching.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Hey, who was in that band? The reeds was who? Was it Lester and -
We had Lester; we had Washington -

No, not Jack. No, Jack wasn't there. It was another Washington, Pinky Washington, and Buster Smith. We had Dee Stewart, (Derwood Stewart, Hot Lips Page, Joe Keys, and Dan Minor. Wait a minute; keep writing. Buster Smith -
I just want to get first to the reeds. The reeds was Lester and -
Washington, but this is another Washington, not Jack.
What did you call his name?
And Buster Smith. The "Father" He was part of Charlie Parker's.

Herschel had stayed in Kansas City with Bennie Moten's band. See, because Herschel and Lester were playing an overnight. They switched. One went for kicks and one went for money. You know that's like you and Duvivier George would maybe say, all right, you go over there and I'll go over here. Overnight. All right, you cool with George, right, so George go over here and get your kicks. I'm tired of making the money. They ain't playing nothing over here. I've got to get out. O.K., you go over there. They switched overnight. They come to work but you couldn't say nothing because you got a good man in each place. Nobody said nothing. (laughs)
Now the trumpets you say were Joe Keyes -
Joe Keyes, Derwood Stewart (Deo Stewart), and Hot Lips Page and Dan Minor.
Now who was the trombones? One?
How many pieces was that, in the rhythm section?
